topSignals.title: Ninth consecutive quiet day for the two priority stacks.
topSignals.text: Elcogen's and Topsoe's newsrooms show no post inside the 24-48h window. Elcogen's latest remains the Sept 21 Metrosert testing-cooperation announcement (21 days old); Topsoe's most recent substantive items remain the H1 2026 results and the Uniper e-methanol FEED contract. Elcogen News | Topsoe News

topSignals.title: Today's rotating benchmark-company searches (Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol, Plansee, Doosan Fuel Cell, Watt Fuel Cell, OxEon Energy, Kawasaki Heavy Industries) surfaced no new datapoints.
topSignals.text: All six came back with either recycled older stories or content that pre-dates the lookback window — see Stack & Cell Technology for detail.

topSignals.title: New non-SOFC competing-power signal: ONE Nuclear Energy signs a binding LOI for a 2.88 GW gas-fired plant plus large-scale battery storage (BESS) co-located with an AI data center campus in Ascension Parish, Louisiana ("Project Cayman").
topSignals.text: Despite the company name, this is a gas+battery project, not a nuclear one — another data point for gas/BESS as the dominant on-site AI-power pathway at multi-GW scale. DatacenterDynamics | Energy-Storage.news

items.text: Elcogen (priority stack):* No new company news in the window. elcogen.com/category/news still lists the Sept 21 Metrosert cooperation announcement as the latest post. A cluster of "Elcogen launches new high-volume SOFC factory" articles (macaubusiness, hydrogen-central, tradewithestonia, investinestonia, timestech) surfaced again today but all trace back to the 360 MW ELCO I Tallinn factory launch already logged in this monitor (May 2026) or an earlier Sept 2025 version of the same story (h2-tech.com dateline confirms 2025) — not new.

Topsoe (priority stack):* No new company news in the window. topsoe.com/news still shows the H1 2026 results and Uniper e-methanol contract as the most recent dated items. No new SOEC/SOFC test result, factory milestone, or partnership identified.
Rotating benchmark-company dedicated searches (this cycle: Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol, Plansee, Doosan Fuel Cell, Watt Fuel Cell, OxEon Energy, Kawasaki Heavy Industries), 7-day lookback:
Fraunhofer IKTS / Kerafol: No dated 2026 news; results were legacy technical publications and institute pages.
Plansee: No dated 2026 news; results were patent filings and older powder-metallurgy-interconnect technical write-ups (SOFC20 project).

Doosan Fuel Cell: No new item. The "$78M Reverion stack supply contract" (evertiq, Sept 18) is the already-logged Aug 5-6 Doosan/Reverion $76.7M deal reported again with a rounded figure — not new. Several "2026 strategy" pieces (enkiai.com) are recycled SEO aggregator content, consistent with the pattern flagged in prior entries.
Watt Fuel Cell: No new item; most recent substantive news (equity financing, first WATT HOME residential installation) is from July 2026, already outside this week's window.

OxEon Energy: No new item. A cluster of "OxEon wins $36M DOE hydrogen funding" stories resurfaced under a 2026-dated URL slug (utahbusiness.com) but the underlying announcement is confirmed 2024-vintage (davisjournal.com, slenterprise.com) — not new.
Kawasaki Heavy Industries: No SOFC-specific news found; results were generic stock/index coverage.
Other key players (Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power):* No new stack/cell-technology-specific announcements beyond items already logged (financial/market news for all three covered below).
